title: pentaschistis angulata
intro: Pentaschistis angulata, commonly known as the mountain grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pentaschistis angulata include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
